subject: n2r DELTA4/6 MRT final: v4 true-MRT + per-target path, 11 PASS
body: Final n2r MRT state. Per-target SELECT_RT emulation is acceptable for the bounded path; n2r single-target R8 (format10) clear/load/store already works. For future true MRT I implemented additive n2r_render_targets/n2r_validate_v4/n2r_build_v4: 1..4 targets, per-target format/load_action/write_mask/address/row_bytes/width/height/clear_words, optional sample_locations; RT descriptors at m+128+64*i, cumulative internal tile offsets, rounded color_buffer_allocation, per-RT blends at m+928, render_target_count and DRAW.render_target_mask from write masks, R8 writeback. sample_locations required for >2 targets, must be inside command block and not overlap the v2 payload. NULL sidecar preserves old packets; v4 NULL compared byte-identical; existing old n2r semantic oracle PASS release+ASan. Host test 3 targets BGRA/BGRA/R8 v9 unpack: count3, allocation3072, offsets0/1024/2048, R8 writeback, blend_count3, mask bit2, sample slots at supplied address, invalid shape refusal with unchanged output. n2r suite 11 PASS release+ASan; helper 806. Formats remain n2r_bpp {10,70,80,115}; integer/A8/sRGB/10-bit etc explicit refusals. True simultaneous MRT and cross-target fetch remain unqualified; render may use per-target jobs now. No phone/build/commit/publish.
